areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: General objective only minimally related; education finance system is a very small share of resources and one indicator covers just part of the objective; low impact.

areas.name: Social security
areas.reason: Minimal link via a pension-management system; tiny share of resources, so potential impact is low and efficiency versus alternatives is not shown.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: General objective minimally related; public-procurement modernization has a relevant resource share but potential impact is low given the number of areas and products.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Link to most indicators not clearly shown; resources only apportioned across areas (relevant share); impact low and no efficiency evidence versus alternatives.

areas.name: State capacity
areas.reason: General objective directly related, SMART indicators and feasible targets; relevant apportioned resource share; moderate but not high impact; innovative versus usual public management.

areas.name: Digital government
areas.reason: Objective relevant, indicators clear and targets feasible; relevant apportioned resource share; impact judged high, with digitalization shown as innovative and efficient.

areas.name: Fiscal sustainability
areas.reason: Objective relevant with many SMART indicators and feasible targets; relevant apportioned share of resources; impact moderate, not high, given resources and target public.
